finals.race: Christmas Parties At Sedgefield Racecourse Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Has enjoyed a profitable season already, winning for a third time in C&D handicap chase in September. Not so good at Hexham since but quickly dropped 2 lb and this is easier.

finals.race: Alder Demain & Akers Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fairly useful maiden on the Flat for Joseph O'Brien. New connections acquired him for 82,000 gns in July. Has been gelded. Interesting runner.

finals.race: Winter Festival 28th & 29th November 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Fairly useful Flat winner (stays 12.5f). Makes hurdles debut after just 4 starts and has to be respected.

finals.race: Winter Festival 28th & 29th November 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Fair maiden on the Flat up to 1¾m, runner-up twice in handicaps this summer. Has the make of a hurdler and a market move would be interesting.

finals.race: Alder Demain & Akers Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fair bumper winner who made it third time lucky over hurdles in a maiden at Uttoxeter (2½m) in September. Bit below that form when 14 lengths second in novice at Fontwell (19f, good to soft) since. Has a bit to find with Trigg.

finals.race: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Bumper winner who has shown ability on all 4 starts over hurdles, placing in maiden at Listowel (2m, good to soft) last time. Should be capable of even better based on bumper form.

finals.race: MW Civils And Groundworks Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: From a successful jumps family and off the mark in Irish points at second attempt (Jan 2026). Yard flying and no surprise to see her have a big say on hurdles debut.

finals.race: Alder Demain & Akers Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: On a hat-trick after wins at Kempton (Flat) and Hereford (hurdle) last month. Well on top at the latter venue 8 days ago and a 7-lb penalty seems unlikely to prevent a bold bid.

finals.race: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Offered little in 4 starts for Lizzie Quinlan last season and drop back in trip is a bit of a concern but she's clearly very interesting following a significant yard switch.

finals.race: Group Discounts For Winter Festival General Admission Rated Hurdle
finals.comment: Won first 2 starts over hurdles and ran well when fifth of 22 to Saratoga in the Fred Winter at the Cheltenham Festival. Suited by step up 2½m when back on the scoresheet in minor event at Punchestown in April and arrives fit following a recent run on the Flat.

finals.race: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Off the mark in hurdle at Wexford last August. Plenty of creditable placed efforts in defeat since. Showed enough to think he's still in form when fifth of 12 over fences at Sligo latest.

finals.race: Canine PREMIER FLEX Plus Joint Supplement Etc Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: A fairly useful Flat winner who recorded easily his best run over hurdles when landing 6-runner handicap at Southwell (15.8f) in May 2025. Seemed to find the quick turnaround taking the edge off him under a penalty at Hexham 8 days later but not seen since.

finals.race: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Shaped as if in form back hurdling after 11 weeks off at Plumpton 2 weeks ago, caught further back than ideal off a steady pace. Can build on that so likely player.

finals.race: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
finals.comment: No promise in maiden hurdles and needs a big step forward now sent handicapping over a longer trip in first-time cheekpieces.

finals.race: Alex & Edward Alder Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Haydock bumper winner for Don Cantillon in May 2025. Best effort over hurdles since when second of 5 in handicap at Fontwell (19f, good) in September. Not in anything like the same form with cheekpieces added at Worcester 19 days later. A tongue tie also goes on now.

finals.race: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Front runner who resumed winning ways at Fontwell in May. Added to an all-or-nothing record after 5 months off at Stratford but the outing might have been needed.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 1)
finals.comment: Became an umpteenth winning stable-switcher for this yard when scoring decisively over C&D last Tuesday and made light of a 5-lb penalty to follow up in 13-runner event at Southwell a couple of days later. Stall 10 not ideal but fancied to complete the hat-trick under a double penalty.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 2)
finals.comment: Became an umpteenth winning stable-switcher for this yard when making all in 14-runner event at Southwell (1m) on Saturday. Stall 11 not ideal but fancied to defy a 6-lb penalty.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 2)
finals.comment: Took a step back in right direction just 3 days on from a lacklustre stable debut when 2 lengths fourth of 10 to Barry The Worm over C&D just over 6 weeks ago. Warrants respect if able to build on that here.

finals.race: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Foaled March 8. 23,000 gns foal, £28,000 yearling, £55,000 2-y-o, Kodi Bear colt. Dam ran once at 2 yrs. Likely outsider on debut.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
finals.comment: Has gained 2 of her 3 wins on all-weather, including last time when producing a career best in 9-runner handicap at Southwell (1m, 3/1) 26 days ago. She was suited by the emphasis on speed then and there's every chance to believe this will be a similar scenario.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
finals.comment: Winless since her debut in France in 2023. Made the frame just once for Joseph Patrick O'Brien on the polytrack at Dundalk in March. Has been off since June and market likely best guide on return for new yard.

finals.race: Midnite Aint Your Grandads Bookie Handicap
finals.comment: Scored at Ripon at the start of September and quickly returned to form on last 2 starts, beaten a nose behind Robert Anstruther at Newmarket last time. This is a rare all-weather outing nowadays but has won on synthetics.

finals.race: Midnite Aint Your Grandads Bookie Handicap
finals.comment: Suited by the drop back to sprinting when second off this mark at York in the summer. Very disappointing since but no surprise if he bounces back starting out for a stable that is having an excellent season.

finals.race: Midnite Built Different Handicap
finals.comment: Fourth of 6 on seasonal reappearance at Southwell in August. Placed both starts over fences since and may need a few to falter.

finals.race: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
finals.comment: Doubled his tally for the season over C&D in September. Unseated leaving the stalls at Haydock next time but back on track with fourth of 7 over 1¾m here 3 weeks ago. Respected. Engaged 7.00 Wolverhampton Monday.
